title: FastWave: Optimized Diffusion Model for Audio Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2603.04122v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audio Super-Resolution is a set of techniques aimed at high-quality estimation of the given signal as if it would be sampled with higher sample rate. Among suggested methods there are diffusion and flow models (which are considered slower), generative adversarial networks (which are considered faster), however both approaches are currently presented by high-parametric networks, requiring high computational costs both for training and inference. We propose a solution to both these problems by re-considering the recent advances in the training of diffusion models and applying them to super-resolution from any to 48 kHz sample rate. Our approach shows better results than NU-Wave 2 and is comparable to state-of-the-art models. Our model called FastWave has around 50 GFLOPs of computational complexity and 1.3 M parameters and can be trained with less resources and significantly faster than the majority of recently proposed diffusion

translated_title: FastWave：用于音频超分辨率的优化扩散模型
translated_abstract: 音频超分辨率是一系列旨在对给定信号进行高质量估计的技术，其目标就如同该信号以更高采样率被采样所得到的效果。在已有的方法中，扩散模型和流模型被认为速度较慢，生成对抗网络被认为速度较快，然而目前这两类方法都由高参数量的网络实现，无论在训练还是推理阶段都需要高昂的计算成本。我们通过重新审视扩散模型训练方面的最新进展，并将其应用于从任意采样率到48 kHz采样率的超分辨率任务，提出了能同时解决上述两个问题的方案。我们的方法取得了优于NU-Wave 2的结果，并与最先进的模型相当。我们将其命名为FastWave，该模型计算复杂度约为50 GFLOPs，参数量仅130万，与近期提出的大多数扩散模型相比，其训练所需资源更少且速度显著更快。
tldr: FastWave是一个轻量级的扩散模型（约50 GFLOPs计算量、130万参数），用于将任意采样率的音频超分辨率提升至48 kHz，其性能优于NU-Wave 2并与最先进模型相当，同时训练所需的资源和时间显著更少。
en_tdlr: FastWave is a lightweight diffusion model (~50 GFLOPs, 1.3M parameters) for audio super-resolution to 48 kHz that outperforms NU-Wave 2 and rivals state-of-the-art models while requiring significantly fewer resources and much faster training than most recent diffusion models.
